description: Discrepancy in Acetaminophen dosing frequency between history and discharge summary.
evidence_in_history: Acetaminophen prescribed as 650 mg every 6 hours prn.
evidence_in_summary: Acetaminophen prescribed as 650 mg every 8 hours prn at discharge.
suggested_correction: Clarify and standardize acetaminophen dosing frequency in discharge instructions and medication list to maintain consistency and safe usage.

description: Azithromycin discontinued at discharge but no explicit mention of alternative antibiotic plan or rationale for non-continuation.
evidence_in_history: Azithromycin prescribed for 5 days (last used on admission date 2023-11-05).
evidence_in_summary: Azithromycin not continued after hospitalization per clinical improvement, but no details on antibiotic stewardship or alternatives.
suggested_correction: Include clear rationale for azithromycin discontinuation and any necessary antibiotic follow-up or monitoring instructions.

description: No explicit follow-up plan for re-assessment of inflammatory markers or lung function post pneumonia resolution.
evidence_in_history: Elevated CRP and WBC during pneumonia episode; spirometry available from 2024-01-15 showing stable COPD.
evidence_in_summary: Follow-up instructions include PCP in 1 week and pulmonology in 6 months but no specific lab or spirometry follow-up.
suggested_correction: Recommend scheduling follow-up labs (CBC, CRP) and pulmonary function tests to monitor resolution and COPD status after pneumonia.

description: No specific instructions on oxygen use or ambulatory oxygen assessment despite initial hypoxemia during admission.
evidence_in_history: ABG showed hypoxemia (pO2 65 mmHg), oxygen saturation 89% on room air at presentation, improved with supplemental oxygen.
evidence_in_summary: Patient discharged on room air with SpO2 95%, but no clear documentation regarding oxygen therapy discontinuation or monitoring.
suggested_correction: Include clear instructions regarding oxygen therapy status post discharge, signs to monitor for hypoxemia, and criteria for oxygen reassessment.

description: No repeat CRP or WBC lab results reported during hospital course or at discharge to demonstrate resolution.
evidence_in_history: Initial CRP 42 mg/L on 2023-11-05 (admission); WBC elevated at 15.2 x10^3/µL.
evidence_in_summary: Summary states labs normalized by discharge but no specific repeat lab values provided.
suggested_correction: Document and include repeat CRP and WBC values to objectively demonstrate resolution of infection.
